name: Tl2O3 cubic bixbyite, 1993 refinement
citation: H. H. Otto, R. Baltrusch and H.-J. Brandt. Further evidence for Tl3+ in Tl-based superconductors from improved bond strength parameters involving new structural data of cubic Tl2O3. Physica C: Superconductivity215 (1993),205–208.
recommendation: experimental source candidate; native FEFF and numerical validation pending
method: Published experimental crystal-structure refinement deposited in AMCSD/COD; the exact diffraction apparatus/method was not independently accessible in the primary article during this selection.
notes: Both crystallographically inequivalent Tl sites included:8b multiplicity8 weight0.25 and24d multiplicity24 weight0.75; each has a complete six-O octahedron.
COD/AMCSD raw author spelling Brant is preserved in original CIF; publisher-deposited Crossref DOI record verifies H.-J.Brandt for the bibliography.
The original CIF omits occupancy; an ordered unit-occupancy model is the parser interpretation, not an independently refined occupancy parameter.
This is a Tl(III) oxide reference; do not present it as a Tl(I) iodide, elementalTl, or generic validated Tl environment.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Neither numerical diffraction temperature nor pressure is present in the original COD CIF. Article fulltext was not accessible; leave both unknown rather than assume room temperature or synthesis conditions.

occupancy.interpretation: Occupancy column absent; unit occupancy is parser interpretation, not an explicit refined occupancy.
